newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to meet budget deficit target - Martin.
newsitem.headline: Canada to meet budget deficit target - Martin.

text.p: Canada is in the midst of an economic recovery, and the government expects to meet its budget deficit target for the current fiscal year ending March, 1997, Finance Minister Paul Martin said.
"It is very clear that the recovery is now well-anchored," he told reporters outside Parliament.
"I think we're going to hit our target," Martin said of the budget deficit for the current fiscal year.
"These are very welcome numbers," he said referring to recent strong economic indicators.

Martin mentioned numerous positive indicators, including rising housing starts and stronger-than-expected manufacturing shipments, the creation of 82,000 jobs in August, as well as higher department store sales.
"It's just a question of maintaining momentum," Martin said.
